text:
alex: beginning scheduled window for account_settings add-col + shadow backfill in 10. Shadow swap path validated. Canaries will run on 3 shards first.
deploybot: [automated] job-started 1748888000: canary_shards=3, controller=shadow-backfill-controller-02. tracking at https://ci.internal/backfills/1748888000 :robot_face:
reema: copy of runbook: 1) create shadow table; 2) backfill with batch_size=250; 3) monitor db p99/p95 and replica lag; 4) perform atomic swap in maintenance slot. rollback if thresholds exceeded.
alex: adding explicit rollback thresholds: error_rate>2% sustained for 3m OR p99>300ms for 5m OR replica_lag>10s for 2m -> abort.
tony: pinning client lib to sql-client-2.1.3 to avoid the row-format change we saw in canary last time.
reema: deploybot, please stream minute snapshots: {replica_lag, processed_rows, errors, p95, p99} and surface dblock info.
deploybot: [automated] snapshot @1748888300: replica_lag=1s, processed_rows=1,120,000, errors=0, p95=62ms, p99=120ms
slo-bot: [automated] SLO alert check: query_lat_p99=120ms (ok), error_rate=0% (ok).
reema: canary looks healthy; increasing canary_shards -> 6.
deploybot: [automated] canary progress: 4/6 shards done, avg_row_rate=410r/s, db_p95=70ms, db_p99=155ms
tony: p99 creeping; set CONCURRENCY=2 and RATE_LIMIT=250.
reema: applied: CONCURRENCY=2 RATE_LIMIT=250 BATCH_SIZE=250
alex: note: if we hit p99>220ms, we first pause new shard pickup and let in-flight finish; do not immediately rollback. Only rollback if post-drain errors spike or lag persists.
reema: seeing a short DDL lock at 1748888605 for 120ms — nothing blocking.
deploybot: [automated] snapshot @1748888900: replica_lag=3s, processed_rows=3,900,000, errors=4, p95=82ms, p99=228ms
alex: p99 over soft threshold. pause new shard assignment. notify if errors>15 while draining.
tony: rolling pause. also notifying oncall pager.
reema: manual inspection: pg_stat_activity shows some autovacuum activity; no long-running exclusive locks. Will let current workers drain for 6m.
slo-bot: [automated] historical baseline p99=115ms. current p99=228ms -> 1.98x baseline (below 2x hard threshold).
reema: drain complete, current errors=6, processed_rows=4,300,000, replica_lag=4s. p99 trending down to 175ms.
reema: resume policy: if p99 < 200ms for 10m resume; else escalate to rollback.
deploybot: [automated] final snapshot @1748889620: replica_lag=2s, processed_rows=6,450,000, errors=9, p95=78ms, p99=168ms. canary paused awaiting resume_command.
alex: agreed. keeping pin on client until full swap completes. writing up rollback runbook: 1) stop backfill workers; 2) promote shadow-table? no, revert swap plan and keep old table; 3) clear feature flags; 4) unpin client and redeploy older image; 5) open postmortem ticket.
tonys: (small typo) -> tony
reema: adding release note: "account_settings.is_active boolean added; default false; backfill executed in migration window; rollback thresholds and contact list included."
alex: thanks all. leaving thread open for final resume command.
